verdict.rationale: Medusa documents and hosts an official Streamable HTTP MCP server at docs.medusajs.com/mcp that can be added to MCP-capable AI agents, and a runtime probe confirms the server is live (though gated behind OAuth for Medusa Cloud accounts). This directly satisfies the story for a non-agent platform product offering an official MCP server. Missing for 10: evidence of full functional scope of the MCP server (e.g., beyond docs Q&A) and confirmation of free/non-gated access for all users.
